name: News, AI Illustrated
description: AI News: once a day, the top story of each of your feeds, summarised by Groq and drawn as a satirical ink cartoon (kie.ai, Gemini, Pollinations or HuggingFace). Shows one story at a time, poster style, moving to the next on each refresh.

cell_options.name: show_summary
cell_options.label: Summary
cell_options.help: The story's summary under the headline, where the cell has room for it.

cell_options.name: show_source
cell_options.label: Source and date
cell_options.help: The feed's label, the story's date and which story of how many.

settings.name: sources
settings.label: Sources
settings.help: One feed per line, as Label | feed URL (RSS or Atom). Each feed gives one story a day: its newest item.

settings.name: run_at
settings.label: Daily at
settings.help: New stories are made at the first panel render after this time (the server's time zone). For an exact time, turn on the placement's daily refresh at the same time.

settings.name: groq_api_key
settings.label: Groq API key
settings.help: Writes the summaries. Without it a story shows the opening words of the article.

settings.name: kie_api_key
settings.label: kie.ai API key
settings.help: Image providers are tried in turn (kie.ai, Gemini, Pollinations, HuggingFace, or the order under More options) and the first picture wins. Leave a key blank to skip that provider.

settings.name: summary_words
settings.label: Summary words
settings.help: About how long each summary is. Short articles get shorter summaries.

settings.name: provider_order
settings.label: Image provider order
settings.help: Any of kie, gemini, pollinations and huggingface, comma separated. A story's picture has 150 seconds across all of them.

settings.name: summary_prompt
settings.label: Summary prompt
settings.default: Summarize this news story in about {words} words. Use simple, plain language that anyone can understand. No jargon, no bullet points, no headers — just clear flowing sentences.
settings.help: {words} is the summary length. Rules against inventing facts are always added.

settings.name: image_prompt
settings.label: Illustration prompt
settings.default: Draw a black and white comic illustration. The comic should be a witty/funny observation or ironic comment on this specific news story like Far Side. Think: what is the absurd or ironic none spoken truth hiding inside this story? Show that moment. Characters should be consistent across all panels, right amount of hands, legs etc. Black and white ink art, bold outlines, dramatic composition, crosshatching for shading. CRITICAL: the ratio should be 9:16, leave the bottom 10% of the image completely empty — no characters, objects, speech bubbles, or any detail whatsoever in that zone. Story for the comic: {summary}.
settings.help: For kie.ai and Gemini; {title} and {summary} are filled in. Pollinations and HuggingFace get a short prompt of their own, which suits FLUX better.

sample.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
sample.summary: Ukraine's defence minister said the country now has a stable Starlink connection after days of limited satellite internet that hampered military operations.
